## Turnkey $0 ZTC OER, NSF AI-Ready America 50-State Enabling Resource & K-16 Dual-Enrollment Course Datasets (KIN / HLTH 4-Tier educationalAlignment Fleet)
- **Non-Competing 50-State Enabling Resource (`NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America` & AWC Southwest Arizona AI Symposium)**: Alan Pruitt and Webcognita LLC **do not compete** against community colleges, universities, or state consortia for primary [NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives/ai-ready) grant awards. Instead, we serve as a proven technical readiness resource, open Curriculum-as-Code reference architecture, and subaward implementation partner supporting **Arizona Western College** (an HSI serving a **77% Latino** [`3.08x` the 25% federal Title V HSI threshold] and **62% first-generation** student body—*"At AWC, 77% of students are Latino, and 62% are first-generation students. We serve this beautiful community, but challenge is everywhere,"* AWC President Dr. Reetika Dhawan, as quoted in *The Yuma Sun*, November 11, 2026—and building on the regional momentum of the AWC-hosted **Southwest Arizona AI Symposium**) and **State & Territory AI-Ready Coordination Hubs across all 50 states**. We transition cohorts from `AI-AWARE` to `AI-READY` using **air-gapped, zero-cloud-footprint local inference** (**Google Gemma E2B/E4B**, **LiteRT-LM**, **Android AICore**, **Apple Silicon Ollama Carbon 4**, triple-hash `###` token isolation, and parallel local subagents via the **Antigravity CLI & SDK**) across higher education, rural agriculture, small businesses, and high-OPSEC/FERPA environments—while our S-A-R compiler absorbs shifting federal portal mandates (including human-in-the-loop safety governance for frontier AI and *superintelligence*) via single-source JSON-LD updates with zero drift.
- **Licensing & Accessibility Verification**: All 5 full-course packages are licensed under **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** (`$0 ZTC`), verified across **419 HTML files with 0 WCAG 2.2 AA (9:1 Double-Contrast Guard) issues**, and annotated with 4-Tier `Schema.org/Dataset` + `LRMI educationalAlignment` structured data (`Tier 1`: `CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.W.11-12.6`, `WA.ELA.11-12.W.6`, `CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RST.11-12.7`; `Tier 2`: Federal Clinical SSoTs `PAGA 2018`, `DGA 2025-2030`, `ACSM 12th Ed.`, `NASM OPT`; `Tier 3`: `U.S. DOL ETA TEN No. 07-25` and `NSF-TECHACCESS-AI-READY-2026`; `Tier 4`: `HLC / AWC ILOs`).

## Production Software & R&D Portfolio (8 Live PWAs)
- [EXW Digital Tool Kit (`exwtoolkit.com`)](https://exwtoolkit.com): 9-Box bilingual (`EN` / `ES`) clinical biometrics, desert heat-stress simulator, and cryptographic verification token workbench (`EXW-[COURSE]-M[XX]-[HASH]`).
- [EXW Physical Activity Tool Kit (`paga2018.dev`)](https://paga2018.dev): $0 ZTC Student OER built on the Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans (2018, 2nd Ed.) with `Pattern / Rule / Solve` clinical activity audits.
- [EXW-Demo — WPE Fleet Architecture & Curriculum-as-Code Hub (`exwdemo.dev`)](https://exwdemo.dev): Zero-login Progressive Web App mirror of AWC Course ID `42051` showcasing Sovereign Three-Stage (`Mandate → System → Proof`) Curriculum-as-Code, WCAG 2.2 AA (`9:1` Double-Contrast Guard) pages, and 256 `10/10` Exemplar Solves.
- [Flavor Architect — Pattern / Rule / Solve Recipe Lab (`flavorarchitect.dev`)](https://flavorarchitect.dev/) & [Food Informatics Consulting (`flavorarchitect.dev/food-informatics`)](https://flavorarchitect.dev/food-informatics): AI-assisted culinary medicine and Food Informatics R&D workbench for the University of Arizona Nutritional Sciences & Wellness (NSW) Foods Lab uniting `Pattern / Rule / Solve`, `###` case-audit delimiters, USDA FDC, DGA 2025–2030 Imperial & Metric prototypes, and menu-to-formulation Food Informatics consulting.
- [Arquitecto del Sabor (`arquitectodelsabor.dev`)](https://arquitectodelsabor.dev/): Bi-national Arizona–Sonora borderlands (`es-MX`) molecular culinary and DGA nutrition R&D engine (*Motor de I+D — Laboratorio de Alimentos de Bienestar de The University of Arizona*) featuring Metric/Imperial cross-border formulations and `MXN` grocery food-access telemetry calibrated for San Luis Río Colorado, Sonora, México and Yuma, AZ.
- [Markdown to Documents (`mdtodocs.app`)](https://mdtodocs.app): Curriculum-as-Code document compiler transforming plain-text Markdown into born-accessible, WCAG-compliant PDF, Word (`.docx`), and semantic HTML documents.
- [Prompt-per-Mile Offset Calculator (`prompt-mile-hero.lovable.app`)](https://prompt-mile-hero.lovable.app): Sustainability telemetry utility converting active-transit miles into CO2 savings and equivalent AI compute prompt offsets.
- [AgFlow 5G — Smart Irrigation & Remote Operations Calculator (`agflow-roi-dash.lovable.app`)](https://agflow-roi-dash.lovable.app): YCEDA desert AgTech pilot utility modeling the operational, financial, and water-conservation ROI of 5G remote irrigation management.
